summary_en: 37,289,600 shares (5.3% of shares outstanding). Price ceiling ¥100/share. Max outlay ¥3,728,960k. Off-market private sale from Dimensional K.K. (warrant exercise residuum). Execution contingent on 2026/09/30 extraordinary shareholder approval. Acquired shares to be cancelled post-acquisition except as needed for fractional-share buy-up requests.
title_en: Notification regarding acquisition of treasury shares from a specified shareholder
translation_en_brief: Convano Inc. announced on 2026/08/24 that its board approved submission to an extraordinary shareholder meeting (scheduled 2026/09/30) of a proposal to acquire 37,289,600 treasury shares from Dimensional K.K. via private off-market transaction. Dimensional acquired the shares through exercise of the Company's Series 4 warrants (with exercise-price adjustment clauses) between July–August 2025. Although Dimensional sold a portion into the market, it determined that disposing of the remaining 37,289,600 shares publicly would require substantial time and risk adverse price impact. At Dimensional's request for off-market sale, the Company elected to acquire all shares via private negotiated sale. Acquisition price is capped at ¥100 per share but may be lower if the closing market price on 2026/09/29 (the day before the shareholder vote) falls below that ceiling; the actual price paid will not exceed the statutory market price. Total outlay is capped at ¥3,728,960k and will be funded entirely from proceeds of the Company's previously completed cryptocurrency asset sale (¥8,098,969k proceeds as of 2026/08/10), not from operating cash reserves. Post-acquisition, all shares will be cancelled as promptly as possible, except those required to satisfy fractional-share buy-up requests under a related stock-consolidation and bylaw amendment (announced separately). The board confirmed that the transaction protects existing shareholders from market-impact risk, applies no preferential pricing versus other shareholders, respects distributable reserves, and will improve per-share metrics through reduction of shares outstanding ex-treasury.
